column1: # An armour set IS an outfit: the same class geometry repainted
# grants. Kept as one table rather than two systems
# "armour set" were the same record under different names.
# Four sets per class; exactly one per class starts unlocked (empty `unlock`).
# tags   every row starts with item:armor; remaining tags are granted while worn

column11: The armour you were buried in.
Blackened at the court that broke.
Kept bright by an oath unbroken.
Dyed with the dark between stars.
Worn only when the moon is eaten.
It catches light that is not there.
Cut for someone taller than you.
Warm long after the fire is out.
Road dust worked into the weave.
Quiet leather for a loud profession.
Dark cloth that swallows the outline.
Cut close so nothing catches the blade.
